why_it_wins: CLEAN evidence (leakage-independent, per adversarial skeptic): grouped-OOF held-out REAL-SPAM false-positive rate is +phish ~37% vs noContent ~3-5% (bootstrap diff +0.33 [0.25,0.42]). content_risk = P(spam)+P(phishing) fires on real spam (median 87); phish_p scores spam~0. 0/574 phish are content-only-rescuable, so dropping content costs no recall.

skeptic_corrections.pAUC_provenance_demoted: The pAUC 0.34->0.96 provenance gap is an isotonic-extrapolation artifact, NOT clean content-vs-nocontent: +phish/beta (WITH content) tops prov pAUC at 0.984. Lead with operating-point real-spam FP rate, not pAUC.
skeptic_corrections.real_phish_recall_contaminated: Nazario/Nigerian are public corpora likely in NLP training; phish_p memorized-high (100%>thr). Degrading real-phish phish_p to synthetic dist drops prov pAUC 0.963->0.758, band-26 real recall 1.0->0.875. Do NOT claim 100% real recall as generalization. Synthetic text families (homoglyph/leet/zerowidth/BEC/obvious) hold out-of-family legitimately.
skeptic_corrections.noContent_vs_phish_incorpus: In-corpus it's a TIE: 20-seed band-26 F1 noContent 0.927+-0.014 vs +phish 0.931+-0.018 (noContent wins 6/20). noContent's advantage is PURELY OOD robustness to real spam. Reframe: not an in-corpus win.
skeptic_corrections.header_domain_shift: band-26 (P>0.255) gives ~21% FPR on synth->real for ALL fusions (synth-trained header maps baseline 10->P=0.227; 99.9% real-legit have header=10). The 0.255 threshold needs real-traffic re-calibration. Whole-pipeline caveat, not content-specific.
skeptic_corrections.int8_crosscheck: PASSED: on broken-INT8 phish_p is dead -> noContent collapses, content better. Finding is genuinely a corrected-fp32 property.
